calculation_handling.description: Amending instruction: adds new regulation 200.5.10.1(13) to Zoning By-law 569-2013.

The required number of parking spaces may be reduced for electric vehicle supply equipment and for support structures attached to a solar parking canopy, subject to conditions including a 0.3 metre clearance from the side of a parking space.
calculation_handling.gaps: The reduction depends on equipment layout facts we do not hold, and the 0.3 metre clearance has no matching target in our vocabulary.

units.disclosure: Required parking can be reduced where electric vehicle supply equipment or solar canopy support structures take up space, subject to conditions such as a 0.3 metre clearance from the side of a parking space. We do not model this reduction, so the parking requirement shown is not reduced.

200.5.10.1(13)@1075-2026.explanation: By-law 1075-2026 adds a rule letting the required number of parking spaces be reduced where electric vehicle charging equipment, or support structures for a solar parking canopy, occupy part of a parking space. Conditions apply, including keeping the equipment inside the original space and at least 0.3 metres from its side.
